yatotatovā: [Yato+tato+vā] (bya) CL=7 (1) By one kind of  (the  dhamma object) which is not recognized/ without mark. (2) Haven"t  mark/sign (or) Not bear in mind (or) Not recognize. By some (dhamma object).
yakkhasayutta: Yakkha+saṃyutta] yakkhasaṃyuta. Sagāthāvaggasaṃyuta,  there has 10 sections, include 12 suttas.
yādisavihāra: [Yādisa+vihāra] (ti) CL=7 One who used to live with Samāpata dhamma which should be meditated. (Samāpata means attainment stage of meditation).
yātānuyāyī: [Yāta+anuyāyī] (ti) CL=7 One who always follow to the front of going person (as the state of support firstly). One who is given the support again for gratitude. See - Yāta-(1).
yojanaparikkhepa: [Yojana+parikkhepa] (ti) CL=7 it has the circumference which is one Yojana  far. (Yojana means measure of distance equal to 12.72 miles)
yojaniyaratanacaṅkoṭaka: [Yojaniya+ratana+caṅkoṭaka] (pu,na) CL=7 A jewellery casket which is about one Yojana size.  (Yojana means measure of distance equal to 12.72 miles).
yuddhakamma: [Yuddha+kamma] (na) CL=7 The matter of fighting a battle.
yuddhasadisa: [Yuddha+sadisa] (ti) CL=7 It"s like fighting a battle.
yuganaddhaniddesa: [Yuganaddha+niddesa] (pu) CL=7 Words which is expressed by elaborate and detail version about (samata,vipassanā) dhamma which should be formed to be pair, Yuganaddhaniddesa).
yujjanta: [Yuja+ya+anti] (kri) CL=7 It is proper (or) It is suitable.
